main_body: autumn tree with clustered canopy and vertical trunk
top_band: bright orange-red top-lit foliage clusters across upper canopy and clump crowns (rows 1-24)
evidence: The tree shows a rounded 3/4 canopy with top-lit orange foliage clusters above a shaded underside (rows 28-33) overhanging a vertical brown trunk (rows 31-45).

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference trees which have fine individual leaf clusters, intricate branch peeking, and gnarled roots, the candidate uses smooth, pillow-like blob clusters for the canopy and a completely straight, plain column trunk with flat-looking base flare.
